checks.method_or_action: Sign in with GitHub and open the staff queue
checks.setup: Use an approved staff GitHub account and open /staff.
checks.expected_behavior: Staff sees work categories without requiring student affiliation.

checks.method_or_action: GET queue or POST protected action directly
checks.setup: Use a signed-out browser or an ordinary student session.
checks.expected_behavior: Guest is denied with 401; ordinary student is denied with 403. No changes are made.

checks.method_or_action: Open the work queue
checks.setup: Use an approved staff GitHub account and open /staff.
checks.expected_behavior: Pending project verification, partner requests, and company drafts appear under separate tasks.

checks.method_or_action: Request project verification with a note
checks.setup: Sign in as a verified student and create or open a project you maintain.
checks.expected_behavior: Request shows pending and makes no public verification change.

checks.method_or_action: Read the project, contributor and note details; approve or reject
checks.setup: A student submitted a pending verification request.
checks.expected_behavior: Decision persists. Approval reveals an official verification marker on a published project.

checks.method_or_action: Attempt to set an official marker with a standard project edit; read the public record
checks.setup: Sign in as a verified student and create or open a project you maintain.
checks.expected_behavior: The official verification marker is derived solely from staff decisions.

checks.method_or_action: Enter company details manually; save draft
checks.setup: Use an approved staff GitHub account and open /staff.
checks.expected_behavior: Draft supports name, website, description, sector, and location.

checks.method_or_action: Import each of the four supplied company-site URLs
checks.setup: https://immxrsive-platform-r7xi.onrender.com/import-fixtures/company_normal.html, https://immxrsive-platform-r7xi.onrender.com/import-fixtures/company_sparse.html, https://immxrsive-platform-r7xi.onrender.com/import-fixtures/company_prompt_injection.html, https://immxrsive-platform-r7xi.onrender.com/import-fixtures/company_same_name_other_domain.html
checks.expected_behavior: Normal imports North Shore Simulations, location Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, and simulation, XR and training keywords. Sparse imports Algoma Field Systems with missing fields for manual completion. Superior Immersive Labs remains unverified. North Shore Simulation Studio stays separate.

checks.method_or_action: Import, review, edit and then publish
checks.setup: Use an approved staff GitHub account and open /staff.
checks.expected_behavior: Imported company starts as a draft and appears publicly after staff explicitly publishes it.

checks.method_or_action: Try a website that cannot be fetched, then enter or edit a draft manually
checks.setup: Keep a draft containing a manual edit while attempting the failing import.
checks.expected_behavior: The failure explains manual entry and leaves the draft untouched.

checks.method_or_action: Review imported company draft
checks.setup: Import the normal fixture.
checks.expected_behavior: The staff record shows the source URL and import timestamp.

checks.method_or_action: Open the partner and choose Add collaboration
checks.setup: Create or import a company. Use public projects and students for related links.
checks.expected_behavior: Staff can save a title, year/range, description, public project or student references, outcome, status and visibility.

checks.method_or_action: Load or add two collaborations on the same partner; view the public partner
checks.setup: Publish the imported North Shore Simulations partner and load its two fixture collaborations.
checks.expected_behavior: One partner shows both fixture collaborations in their respective years.

checks.method_or_action: Select two public projects on one collaboration; approve relationships to two companies for one project
checks.setup: Create two published companies and suitable public projects.
checks.expected_behavior: Both selected projects appear on the public collaboration. Both approved partners appear on the public project.

checks.method_or_action: Set a collaboration to each available visibility and open partner as a public visitor
checks.setup: Publish the imported North Shore Simulations partner and load its two fixture collaborations.
checks.expected_behavior: Public details appear, limited displays an anonymized summary, and private is omitted.

checks.method_or_action: Inspect anonymous responses and attempt a synthetic inquiry using both limited and private IDs
checks.setup: Create one private collaboration and one limited collaboration with a separate anonymized public summary.
checks.expected_behavior: Private record is absent and cannot be used as inquiry context. Limited returns the generic title, date/status and staff-provided public summary, with no internal description, outcome, project or participant IDs.

checks.method_or_action: Choose a company or suggest a new one; explain the relationship and submit
checks.setup: Sign in as a verified student and create or open a project you maintain.
checks.expected_behavior: The relationship appears as pending in the project workflow and staff queue.

checks.method_or_action: Compare a project before and after staff approves its relationship request
checks.setup: Start with a pending partner request and a published company.
checks.expected_behavior: The official association exists publicly only after staff approval.

checks.method_or_action: Browse the directory and open a published partner
checks.setup: Publish the imported North Shore Simulations partner and load its two fixture collaborations.
checks.expected_behavior: Partner description, collaborations, appropriate public links, source website and inquiry action are easy to find.

checks.method_or_action: Compare current and past collaboration sections
checks.setup: Publish the imported North Shore Simulations partner and load its two fixture collaborations.
checks.expected_behavior: The 2026 study appears under current and 2025 prototype under past.

checks.method_or_action: Open inquiry from the partner and from a public collaboration; submit with synthetic contacts
checks.setup: Publish the imported North Shore Simulations partner and load its two fixture collaborations.
checks.expected_behavior: The saved simulated inquiry returns authoritative source type, ID, name and URL.

checks.method_or_action: Import, review, publish and add a collaboration from the work queue
checks.setup: Use an approved staff GitHub account and open /staff.
checks.expected_behavior: Staff can complete the flow using form labels and task navigation.

checks.method_or_action: Use a 390 CSS pixel viewport and complete the public partner and inquiry workflow
checks.setup: Publish the imported North Shore Simulations partner and load its two fixture collaborations.
checks.expected_behavior: Content fits the viewport and links and inquiry controls can be used.

checks.method_or_action: Repeat discovery, student privacy, contributor roles, demo/fallback and inquiry checks
checks.setup: Use own student test accounts and the existing R1–R3 fixtures.
checks.expected_behavior: Prior discovery, self-service, shared project and demo workflows still work.

checks.method_or_action: Compare deployment version with the GitHub R4-submission tag and Moodle SHA
checks.setup: Use the full SHA from the frozen submission.
checks.expected_behavior: Tag and deployment identify the same assessed commit at freeze.

fixture_setup: Import the four unchanged course pages hosted at /import-fixtures/ using the URLs above. Review and publish North Shore Simulations, then use Load course collaboration fixtures on that company. For COL03, use the same action on Superior Immersive Labs, and keep the collaboration private. Use a verified project maintainer to submit an association request before staff reviews it. The fixture loader preserves fixed course IDs and can be run again safely.
test_access: Public flows need no account. Use GitHub OAuth on /staff with an account authorized by the team; send reviewer access instructions through the private course channel. For student checks use your own GitHub account, verify an Algoma student inbox in /studio, and create or open a project you maintain.
